primary_channel.name: X/Twitter
primary_channel.purpose: Reach BSS owners/operators, beauty supply buyers, braiders/stylists, and wholesale/retail observers with practical item-level insights.

allowed_autonomous_content: Evidence-backed ranking link with UTM parameters
One practical retail-owner display/reorder tip from the live page
Clear label when an item is WATCHLIST or evidence is insufficient
Short English post copy targeting Beauty Supply Store owners
manual_approval_required_for: First live post after account connection
Replies, quotes, DMs, follows, likes, reposts, or user-targeted engagement
Paid ads, boosted posts, budget spend, or promotional claims
Medical/growth efficacy claims, price guarantees, supplier accusations, or unverifiable trend claims
Any post that mentions a person/account directly or uses third-party images/media uploads
hard_guardrails: No trend claim unless there is a dated captured source URL
Do not expose secrets, internal tokens, private review notes, or raw strategy files
Every post URL must include utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic and a campaign id
If analytics or xurl is unavailable, create drafts only and report the blocker

recommended_post_template.name: daily_owner_item_insight
recommended_post_template.text: Beauty Supply owners: this week’s ranking highlights {item_name}. Display test: {display_tip}. Evidence and supply links are separated so you can judge what is trend vs. watchlist. {url}

weekly_thread_template: 1/ This week’s BSS item ranking: what to test on the floor now — with trend evidence separated from supply/watchlist links.
2/ Top evidence-backed item: {item_name}. Why it matters: {reason_summary}
